selections.description: Adopt the upstream HTTP client's retry policy and keep its observable behavior aligned. The target may use a different language or HTTP library.
acceptance: Transient failures follow the upstream retry count, delays, cancellation, and final-error semantics.
New and changed upstream behavior tests have corresponding target regression coverage.

selections.description: Reflect relevant API documentation changes using the target's public names and examples; do not copy upstream branding or language-specific setup.
acceptance: Examples agree with the implemented target API and all changed docs links remain valid.

preserve: Keep target-specific authentication and deployment behavior.
Do not adopt upstream UI features, branding, or telemetry unless a selection explicitly requests them.
Do not break the target's public API silently; report blocked when adaptation requires a design decision.
